sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Needle in a Haystack is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You're just in time! I have studied the manager's diary and prepared for you a list of facilities that appear most often in the records. You need to investigate all of these locations. So far, I can't tell what exactly to look for. Maybe you'll find equipment or other traces of TerraGroup around there. Focus on these locations and look around."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Investigate the courtyard park by TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero
- Investigate the kart track on Interchange
- Investigate the indoor children's playground on Interchange
- Investigate the children's playground by Concordia on Streets of Tarkov
- Investigate the coast-side construction site on Shoreline
- Investigate the children's playground by the Health Resort on Shoreline

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +9,800 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 47,000 Roubles
  - 49,350 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 54,050 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- 5× Light bulb
- 5× Energy-saving lamp
"Really, nothing at all? Perhaps it really is just a coincidence... I'll have to think about it and check my sources again."

sections.heading: Ground Zero
sections.text: In front of the TerraGroup building.

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: In front of the shopping mall and inside in front of the IDEA store.

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: In the courtyard of the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: Behind the health resort east wing and at the construction site along the southern main road.
